name: local_courseplanner_rules
description: Walkthrough for the Academic Timeline Rules page (local_courseplanner).

steps.title: School-year dates
steps.content: Dates describe your school year: the first and last day of classes, days with no class, day swaps, and other notes. Once they are set, apply them to generate the week rows and closed-day markers on the calendar.

steps.title: Add a date
steps.content: Click here to add a date. You need a First day of classes and a Last day of classes. Add a No class date for each holiday or closure, and use Day swap for days that follow a different weekday's schedule.

steps.title: Your dates
steps.content: All of this calendar's dates. Deactivate leaves a date out of the next Apply without deleting it; Delete removes it for good.

steps.title: Apply the dates
steps.content: Click Apply Dates to Calendar when you're ready. The week rows, no-class markers and day-swap notes are regenerated. Anything you added to cells yourself is kept; only the generated content is refreshed.
